provenance_notes.reason: N=16 report cell was measured immediately after a 5-minute functional suite and was ~10% slow (324.0 ms vs 291.9 ms control); the whole N=16 ring was re-measured on the same build and host under steady state.

scope_notes: Report and ordinary timers are separate; combined_median_ms adds separately measured medians.
Ordinary proof payload is 49,208 bytes for every N; the ring report proof is 50,638 bytes.
Communication rows are byte accounting from measured fixtures and compiled constants; no network transfer was measured.
All timings are Rosetta-translated x86_64 execution on an Apple Silicon host.
External schemes have no matched executable benchmark beyond the pinned Chiang et al. baseline.
